claim_checks.claim: TLS migration timing uses 25% emigration criterion + fixed 40-day period (Vollset et al. 2021; EG reports 2017, 2022) — acoustic telemetry in review (earlier, shorter migration) not incorporated into TLS estimates
claim_checks.extract_quote: the modelled migration time applied by the EG is derived from selected data limited to observations of 25% smolt emigration [6] and from duration of the migration period being set/fixed to 40 days for all rivers [2, 3].
claim_checks.note: The extract confirms the claim about migration timing and the exclusion of acoustic telemetry data.

claim_checks.claim: Calibration compensation fails if both larvae-production inputs and observational calibration data are unreliable — uncertainties do not cancel
claim_checks.extract_quote: if both input data to the models (estimated lice larvae) and the model calibration data (lice counts on fish) have several sources of unreliability, any counteracting effect as claimed in the Comment [4], would be negated.
claim_checks.note: The extract supports the claim about calibration compensation failure.

claim_checks.note: The extract supports the claim about discussing calibration uncertainty.
